description: This PHP file defines the 'FilterProjectPostEvent' class, which extends Symfony's Event class and encapsulates a Post object related to project posts within the Goteo application. It is used to represent an event for filtering project posts.

classes.name: FilterProjectPostEvent
classes.description: An event class used in the Goteo application to encapsulate a blog post related to a project, facilitating filtering mechanisms via event dispatching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a specific Post object.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Returns the Post object associated with this event.
